title: Just one of those things - CARMEN MCRAE

lines.l: Just one of those crazy things, one of those bells that now and then rings, just one of those things, it was just one of those nights, just one of those fabulous flights, a trip to the moon on gossamer wings, just one of those things.
If we thought a bit about the end of it, when we started painting the town, we'd have been aware that our love affair was too hot not to cool down.
So goodbye, dear, and amen
Here's hoping we'll meet now and then
It was great fun, but just one of those things
